newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chung Hwa says shares remain suspended.
newsitem.headline: Chung Hwa says shares remain suspended.

text.p: Packaging products maker Chung Hwa Development Holdings Ltd said trading in its shares and warrants would remain suspended pending further notice.

Chung Hwa said it was advised by the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) that the suspension relates strictly to its enquiries into trading of the shares and the sufficiency of information available in the market concerning Chung Hwa's recent business developments.
"The company has been advised by the SFC that it does not have any concerns in relation to the conduct of the company's affairs, its financial position, assets or operations," it said.
Trade in Chung Hwa shares and warrants was suspended on January 17 at the request of the SFC.
Chung Hwa said the SFC was concerned particularly about the company's diversification from its original core business of manufacturing and sale of packaging products last year.
The SFC has requested Chung Hwa to issue a circular providing further information concerning all recent business developments of the company, it said.
Chung Hwa said it is in the process of preparing the circular, which will be despatched to share and warrant holders as soon as practicable. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
